hints.title: Synchronous Parallel Tree Traversal
hints.text: Traverse original and cloned binary trees in lockstep. The node in the clone matching the original traversal target is the answer.

hints.title: Pointer Identity Comparison
hints.text: When original node equals target reference, return the current cloned node reference.

hints.title: Recursive Search Blueprint
hints.text: If original is null, return null. If original is target, return cloned. Search left; if found return it, otherwise search right.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Visits each node once in the worst case until target reference is matched.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching value alone fails when duplicate tree values exist across multiple distinct nodes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual traversal consumes recursion stack proportional to tree height H.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reference identity checking rather than value comparison to handle duplicate values.
